_comment: Words per minute measured per block for V7Voice (NOpBlnGInO9m6vDvFkFC), eleven_multilingual_v2. Per-block, not averaged: the spread is 113-145 wpm and is driven by fragment density, not by the voice. A flat rate under-predicted the script by ~30s and would have pushed it over the cap. Used only to PREDICT cue times before the audio exists; capture/retime-captions.mjs overwrites them with measured values the moment an mp3 is on disk.
